scenes.title: The Impregnable Fortress
scenes.summary: Denis has been courting Katya for a whole week like an impregnable fortress and uses a talking toy to pester her into going to the movies.

scenes.title: A Father's Consent
scenes.summary: Katya tells Denis that she likes him too, but claims her father Chef Barinov is against their relationship and nothing in their family is decided without his consent.

scenes.title: A Daughter's Morning Call
scenes.summary: After waking up startled beside Eva, Chef Barinov receives a phone call from Katya asking him to turn Denis down when Denis comes to ask for his blessing.

scenes.title: The Matchstick Ancestral Estate
scenes.summary: Sous-chef Lyova asks Chef Barinov to hide his painstakingly glued 1:60 scale matchstick model of his family's ancestral estate in the office before his mother's big cleaning.

scenes.title: Allergy to the Good Life
scenes.summary: Dmitry Nagiyev returns from Bali with a severely swollen allergic face and sleeping pills that make him sleep twenty hours a day like a bear.

scenes.title: The Corporate Party in Ten Days
scenes.summary: Vika and German see Nagiyev's swollen face and panic because Sibgazbank already paid a deposit for a big corporate party that Nagiyev must host in ten days.

scenes.title: Count Dracula for Halloween
scenes.summary: German suggests turning the corporate party into a Halloween celebration and dressing Nagiyev up in makeup as Count Dracula before Nagiyev falls asleep.

scenes.title: The Burned-Down Palace
scenes.summary: While a guest asks for a sommelier, Chef Barinov accidentally burns down Lyova's matchstick estate with his cigar and promises to rebuild it in two days.

scenes.title: Sommelier Courses
scenes.summary: Bartender Kostya poses as a sommelier and recommends the most expensive wine to a knowledgeable guest with lamb; Nastya suggests enrolling Kostya in sommelier courses.

scenes.title: A Test for Denis
scenes.summary: Denis asks Chef Barinov for permission to date Katya, and Barinov cunningly challenges him to assemble the matchstick palace to earn his trust.

scenes.title: The Halloween Menu
scenes.summary: German presents his spooky Halloween dishes to Vika—almond-nail finger eclairs, Belgian chocolate spiders, and seafood soup with a dough octopus.

scenes.title: The Italian Moccasins
scenes.summary: After another morning with Eva, Chef Barinov arrives at work as Nagiyev shows off his handmade Italian Giovanni moccasins worth two hundred thousand rubles.

scenes.title: A Home for a Vampire
scenes.summary: Vika and German show Nagiyev his Dracula costume and the locked vampire coffin prop that he must step out of during the Halloween show.

scenes.title: Nagiyev's Slippers
scenes.summary: When Denis finishes gluing the matchstick estate, Katya tells her father to give him an impossible task like in Gogol's tale—stealing Nagiyev's moccasins.

scenes.title: An Important Prop
scenes.summary: While sleepy Nagiyev climbs into the vampire coffin for a quiet nap, Vika accidentally orders the movers to carry the heavy prop coffin down to the basement.

scenes.title: Nastya's Childhood Memories
scenes.summary: Nastya catches Kostya tasting wine in the middle of the day and tearfully explains that her father drank when she was little.

scenes.title: Stealing the Moccasins
scenes.summary: Denis slips Nagiyev's red moccasins off the sleeping owner's feet inside the coffin and accidentally snaps the padlock shut before the coffin is carried downstairs.

scenes.title: A Cruel Joke and a Voice from the Coffin
scenes.summary: Denis brings Nagiyev's moccasins to Chef Barinov, who confesses that he and Katya were just pranking him; meanwhile Ainura hears Nagiyev shouting from the coffin in the basement.

scenes.title: A Family Lesson at the Bar
scenes.summary: Heartbroken over Katya's prank, Denis drinks cheap tequila with Kostya; when Nastya catches Kostya smelling of alcohol, she decides to drink too so he can see how it looks.

scenes.title: The Puppeteer and the Puppet
scenes.summary: After the coffin drops on stage, German nobly defends Vika so Nagiyev docks everyone half a month's pay; Vika kisses German, Katya warms up to Denis, and Eva tells Chef Barinov she is pregnant.
